fusions.name: Stooping Descent
fusions.desc: Bounds up to 7 tiles onto the target and lands for 14 damage, leaving it [Stunned] for 1 second and 10% easier to wound for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Downdraft Roar
fusions.desc: Roars a gale in a cone 5 tiles long, dealing 26 damage to everything in it. The damage ignores resistances.

fusions.name: Lofted Bound
fusions.desc: Carries you 5 tiles forward in one bound. Your movement speed rises 20% for 3 seconds after you land.

fusions.name: Tailwind Lope
fusions.desc: Every few paces you cover restores 7 stamina. Once every 6 seconds.
